restaurant_name: คลินทันตกรรมทันตแพทย์สวนดอกอัครพล
text: I took my daughter to get her front teeth filled. It cost 500 baht per tooth. The dentist did a great job and the price was very reasonable considering the current economic situation. Highly recommend! ((Other places charge 700 baht or more depending on the area of ​​the decay, which is too much for me!)) The clinic is simple and unpretentious, not fancy at all, but acceptable.
